result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would give people a deeper, more consistent capacity for empathy: the ability to truly understand and care about the experiences of others.

So many problems—conflict, inequality, cruelty, neglect—stem from an inability or unwillingness to see others as fully real and deserving of dignity. If empathy were stronger and more widespread, many other changes would follow naturally: better cooperation, kinder policies, less exploitation, and more willingness to help those who are suffering.
